pergunta: Where does Andrew want to live to give their dog a large, open space to run around?

focused_selection.text:
Session date: 9:48 am on 8 July, 2023
[D11:3] Andrew: That's awesome! Dogs really make life more fun doesn't it. I wish I could get one, but like I said, it's tough to find a place and find the right dog. How did you get yours?
[D11:4] Audrey: Thanks! I got lucky finding a breeder nearby that has the dogs I wanted. Yeah places that allows dogs are really hard to find unfortunately .
[D11:5] Andrew: Yeah it's tough. I found a few parks where you can take your pup on a leash, but it's not the same as having an open area where they can run and play. If I find something, I'll let you know. 
[D11:6] Audrey: Cool, I should join you for a hike and bring my dogs. It would be great to have a chance where they can run freely.
[...]
[D11:9] Andrew: Looking forward to seeing them have fun hiking. Let's get planning for next month! Here's the map for the trail.
[D11:10] Audrey: Yep! I'm gonna look into the trail for my furry friend to run around.
[D11:11] Andrew: Sounds good! Let's make sure the trail is safe for the dogs to run around and have fun.
[D11:12] Audrey: Yep! After all safety is top priority when the dogs are outside running around.
[...]
[D11:32] Audrey: I hiked this last year! It was a 3 hour drive from me and the sunset was amazing!
[D11:33] Andrew: Nice! That sunset with the view is amazing, especially with nature around.
[D11:34] Audrey: It was a beautiful moment indeed! The colors were so vibrant, and it felt so peaceful. I'm so grateful for moments like these that remind me of the beauty of nature and to appreciate the small things.
[...]
Session date: 10:05 am on 11 July, 2023
[D12:9] Andrew: Wow, that's so cool. You really put so much love into making them, which makes them extra special.
[D12:10] Audrey: Thanks! I did put a lot of love into making these tags. I want my pets to feel seen and loved.
[D12:11] Andrew: It really are the small things like these show we care a ton about out pets.

Session date: 4:22 pm on 13 October, 2023
[D23:6] Audrey: Wow, looks great! Can I bring my pups with me?
[D23:7] Andrew: Hmmm, not sure if it's suitable for them but hey, there's a great dog park close by! Maybe we can bring our coffee over.
[D23:8] Audrey: Sounds good! Exploring new places is always an adventure for them.
[D23:9] Andrew: Aww, they look so sweet in that sweater! Do they enjoy going to the dog park?
[D23:10] Audrey: The dog park is like paradise for them! They love socializing with the other pups and getting lots of exercise. It's so cute to watch them running around and smelling all the stuff. Do you have any funny stories about your pup at the dog park?
[D23:11] Andrew: There was this one time my pup got too excited and chased a squirrel. He ran around the tree and the squirrel just watched from the branches. It was hilarious!
[D23:12] Audrey: Haha, that must've been hilarious! What breed is your pup again? He looks so fun! My dogs love running around the park. But one thing they hate is snow. I took them to a snowy one last winter and they were so confused! They definitely prefer nice, sunny days in the grass.
[D23:13] Andrew: My pup Toby is German Shephard and loves cute sweaters! He's so active. What games do your dogs like to play at the park?
[D23:14] Audrey: My dogs go crazy for Fetch and Frisbee, and they love to run around and meet other pups. They could keep running for hours!
[D23:15] Andrew: That sounds like so much fun! It's great to see them happy and active.
[...]
[D23:17] Andrew: Yeah, they really do bring joy don't they. It's wonderful.
[D23:18] Audrey: I think i've said this so many times, but I really can't imagine my life without them - my little family. They always make me smile and give lots of love and companionship. Remember I had a tattoo of my four dogs? So I went to the tattoo parlor and got some more drawings on the tattoo.
[D23:19] Andrew: Wow, that's cool! Any plans on getting more? Or are you finished?

Session date: 10:47 am on 6 May, 2023
[D5:2] Audrey: Sounds like a fun and demanding task! Getting to meet new pups must bring so much happiness. What  do you think you can do to make the process smoother?
[D5:3] Andrew: Meeting all these adorable pups has been awesome! For those considering getting a pup, the size of living space and the exercise needs of the breed are important. For me, a person living in an apartment, a smaller dog would be best, but if one is active, consider getting one that loves to play and run.
[D5:4] Audrey: That's some good advice! It's important to consider the space and energy needs of a dog.
[D5:5] Andrew: Yeah! Finding a pet-friendly place to live has been tough too. I'm contacting landlords and checking out neighborhoods to find the perfect spot.
[D5:6] Audrey: Guessing it's tough to find housing. Any particular part of town you want to live in?
[D5:7] Andrew: I'm looking for a place near a park or woods, so I can stay close to nature and give the dog a large open space to run around
[D5:8] Audrey: That's a good plan! I'm lucky to have a park near me - it's great for my pup's walks. Last Friday we took a road trip - we went to a beautiful national park and my dogs had a blast! It was an awesome trip!
[...]
Session date: 2:03 pm on 11 May, 2023
[D6:3] Andrew: That's awesome! Glad have the opportunity to bond with your pets. That workshop sounds cool. Where did you hear about it? And the one in the picture is adorable!
[D6:4] Audrey: I know right? I saw this workshop flyer at my local pet store. It was a positive reinforcement training class and I wanted to give it a shot. The volunteer in the store was nice enough to let me meet their dog – he was so friendly and playful!
[D6:5] Andrew: Cool! Positive reinforcement can really help you bond with your dogs. Do you think they'll catch on quickly?

Session date: 11:27 am on 2 June, 2023
[D7:7] Audrey: It was really special. Nature always cheers me up and makes me feel grateful. Glad you could experience it too. Oh, how are things going with your search for a furry friend?
[D7:8] Andrew: I'm still on the hunt, but it's tough finding a pet-friendly spot in the city. Been checking out some places, but no luck so far. A bit discouraged but I'm determined to find the right place and dog.
[D7:9] Audrey: Oof, Hang in there, you'll find the perfect place for you and your new furry friend.
[D7:10] Andrew: Thanks! I won't give up. 
[D7:11] Audrey: I'm here to support! Email me your criterias so I can help you find a great spot for your furry friend.

Session date: 7:59 pm on 4 November, 2023
[D27:1] Andrew: Hey Audrey, had a great weekend! My girlfriend and I went on a bike ride and stumbled upon a cool park outside of town. It was awesome to get away from the city and be surrounded by nature.
[D27:2] Audrey: That's cool! I love checking out new parks with my four pups. Last weekend was so fun - our dogs were able to run around and get some fresh air. On top of that, I recently joined a dog owners group to learn how to better take care of them.
[D27:3] Andrew: That sounds great! Your four pups must have a lot of fun. How often do you hang out with the dog owners group?
[D27:4] Audrey: Yeah, they're having a lot of fun. I try to meet up with other dog owners once a week for tips from other parents and so they can all play together. How about you? Have you ever thought about joining one?
[D27:5] Andrew: That looks fun! Seeing those adorable pups made me think about getting another dog, but I'm still not sure. Having two dogs is already a lot to take care of. Do you have any tips on being a multi-dog pet owner?
[D27:6] Audrey: Maybe you want to take care of Toby and Buddy first. Having them happy and healthy would be a good first step before going all in for more dogs.
[...]
[D27:14] Audrey: We give them lots of activities to keep them busy - puzzles, training, hide-and-seek - they love it all!
[D27:15] Andrew: Cool ideas! I think I'll give those activities a try with my pups. Thanks!
[D27:16] Audrey: No problem, glad I could help. Let me know how it goes.
